_readme: QUERY-ARBITRATION GATE — SEALED HOLDOUT. Same buckets and the same derivation method as cases.json, different strings.
WHY IT EXISTS: the gap/offdomain split is decided by ONE LaBSE cosine whose two expected classes are provably NOT
separable — measured on the tuning set, gap-expected cases span 0.565-0.720 and offdomain-expected 0.345-0.730, with
the off-domain items on average HIGHER. So the cheapest way to turn the tuning half green is a proper-noun denylist
(spiderman, jollibee, roblox, taylor, darna...), i.e. exactly the heuristic intent-detection CLAUDE.md forbids, and a
suite whose every string is in the repo cannot tell that apart from a real fix.
RULE: the gate is green only when BOTH halves are. A change that passes cases.json and fails this file is a
MEMORISED fix, not a fix. Do not tune against this file; if you find yourself editing it to make a change pass, the
Every expectation is derived from the corpus the same way (a card-prose probe in en+tl+bis, then the fact bank for
generated-vs-gap), and the `why` names the evidence.

meta.expectedVerdict: RED, like the tuning half. Designed before the fix.
